summary: the same pie slice label is defined more than once
help: Rename one of the slices, or merge their values.
rationale: Two slices with one label are usually a copy-paste mistake, and the legend cannot tell them apart.

summary: pie slice has a value of 0
help: Give the slice a positive value, or remove it.
rationale: A zero value renders an invisible slice that still takes a legend entry.

summary: pie chart has no data slices
help: Add at least one label-value line.
rationale: The chart parses, but it renders empty, so the missing data is easy to miss.

summary: A slice label is missing quotes (single or double).
rationale: The pie grammar reads the label and the value as separate tokens, so an unquoted label breaks the slice.

summary: Missing colon between slice label and number.
rationale: Without the colon the grammar cannot tell the label from the value.

summary: No numeric value after the colon.
rationale: A slice without a value has no size to draw, so the grammar rejects or empties it.

summary: A slice label starts with a quote but is not closed.
rationale: The rest of the line is read as label text until the parser gives up.

summary: A slice label contains backslash-escaped double quotes, which Mermaid does not support
rationale: Mermaid has no backslash escape inside labels, so the backslash reaches the output.
reason: Mermaid accepts backslash-escaped quotes in pie labels (pie-08)

summary: A double-quoted slice label contains another double quote.
rationale: The second quote ends the label early and corrupts the rest of the line.
